newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pan Arab games opened in Beirut on Saturday, the first since Lebanon's 15-year civil war ended in 1990.
- Kuwait's acting prime minister said Kuwait's relations with Jordan, Yemen and Sudan had not been suspended.
- Subscription in Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank reached $3.4 billion.
- Turkish Islamist leader Erbakan warns of chaos in Turkey.
- Qatar asks Egypt for reasonable tax on ships carrying gas through Suez Canal.
- Credit facilities of Palestinian banks increased to $541 million in May from $505 million in April.
- Alexandria National Iron and Steel to set up projects at a cost of $353 million.
